name: MediaCard
description: An enhanced card layout for displaying media content with various loading states and fallbacks. Supports image media with optimized loading, loading states with spinner, error state fallback, and hover animations.
usage: Support for image media with optimized loading
Consistent styling based on the Card component
Uses Next.js Image component for optimized image loading
Images have priority loading enabled by default
Appropriate sizes attribute is set for responsive images
Hover animations are applied to the image for interactive feel
Integration with the Card component system for consistency
examples:
<MediaCard
  title="Coming Soon"
  subtitle="New content will be added shortly"
  href="/placeholder"
/>

<MediaCard
  title="Dynamic Content"
  subtitle="Interactive visualization"
  href="/visualizations/dynamic"
  particleVariant="minimal"
/>

<MediaCard
  title="Interactive Card"
  href="#"
  imageSrc="/images/interactive.jpg"
  onCardClick={(e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // Custom click behavior
    openModal();
  }}
/>
design: Loading: Shows a spinner until the image loads
Error: Shows a placeholder if image fails to load
No Image: Shows either a particle background (if particleVariant is provided) or a simple placeholder icon

props.name: imageSrc
props.description: URL for the image to display

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS class for controlling aspect ratio

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the card

props.name: imageClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the image
